contexts.text: The waters were in going and failing () = that falsities began to disappear.
Abraham went () = progression to Divine things. AC 1457.
They went forth to go into the Land of Canaan () = that He thus advanced to the celestial things of love.
Ye shall arise in the morning and go on your way () = confirmation in good and truth.
She went and sat by herself overagainst () = a state of thought... To go, here to go away from the boy, = removal from spiritual truth...
They went together to Beersheba () = progression in the doctrine of charity and faith...
To go after me () = ... to be separated from the Natural, and conjoined with the Rational. AC 3042.
He went () = initiation thereby.
To go () = to depart.
They went after the man () = under the auspices of Divine truth natural... To go after, or follow, = under guidance, or auspices.
And went () = life. (For) to go = to progress into those things which are of good, that is, which are of life... almost the same as to journey, to sojourn, and to progress.
To increase, to go in going, and to become exceeding great () = increasings of good in their order, namely, from truth to good, and from good to truth.
They went to Padan Aram () = to imbue the Knowledges of that good and truth; (for) to go and to journey = the order and purpose of life...
To go () = life. References.
I will go () = conjunction with the Divine Rational; (for) to go, namely, to his place, and to his land, = a longing for conjunction with the Divine of the Rational.
Now in going thou hast gone () = that, from proprium, he had separated himself; (for) to go in going = to be separated.
Jacob went to his way () = what is successive of truth...
Let us journey and go () = what is successive, namely, of the conjunction of good with truth; (for) to journey, and to go... involve progression to further things...
To go near thee () = adjunction; here, that they were to be conjoined; namely, good with truths.
He went () = life. Explained... It appears to Spirits and Angels that they also progress and move from place to place... but it is changes of the state of life which produce that appearance.
Go ye unto Joseph () = that it is from the Celestial of the Spiritual... To go to him = that it is from him...
They went thence () = life thence; (for) to go = to live. AC 5522.
To go () = to live; and because there follows and we will live, to go = the first spiritual life.
To go, or to go away, () = to live, also to live further off, thus also to leave; thus it = to be concealed.
I will go and see him before I die () = a longing for conjunction previous to a new state; (for) to go and see = to be conjoined...
To go to Pharaoh () = to go to infesting falsities. The reason it also = to remove, is...
To go = life. AC 6915. AC 7014. AC 7061. AC 8417. AC 8707:end.
To go and return = what is successive of life.
To go = to live. AC 10567. AC 10627. AE 652:10. AE 768.
To go with you () = that they are to be left, in order that they may worship the Lord...
To go and do () = to obey.
Go ye () = that they should altogether depart.
Jehovah went before them () = the I continual presence of the Lord.
To go by day and night () = life in both states.
And went after them () = protection lest the falsity of evil should How into the will.
Occurs.
To go and descend = influx.
This is the way, go ye in it () = the truth of doctrine and the good of life.

When My Angel shall go before thee () = life according to the Lord's precepts; (for) to go before thee, when said of the Lord, who is here the Angel of Jehovah, = to teach the precepts of faith and life, thus also a life according to these precepts. That to go, and to journey = to live. References.
Arise, make us gods who may go before us () = falsities of doctrine and of worship... To go before us = the things which they may follow, thus according to which they may institute worship.
My Angel shall go before thee () = that still Divine truth will lead.
To go with us... = the Divine leading...
To go, to walk, etc. = the progressions of life.
(I have seen) the goings and walkings of Spirits (in the ways there), according to their affections and derivative thoughts.
To go in the ways of Jehovah () = to live according to the truths of doctrine.
Go ye and we will go in the light of Jehovah () = ... to live according to Divine truth, thus in the life of wisdom.
To go, and to walk, after God, etc. = to follow and acknowledge at heart; also to be and to live with them; and to be consociated. Illustrated. AE 787:2. AE 864.
